name: m3-private-workspace
description: docs/specs/private-workspace.md: the private workspace is Firefox's private window, reached by keys only. It first waits for search.json.mozlz4, which SearchSettings writes once SearchService has initialized: a window opened before that keeps the URL bar's engine-less placeholder and magnifier icon until something is typed (SmartbarInput's deferred update), so the screenshot would show either URL bar depending on timing (#236). ctrl+b shift+p opens it (state: private, workspace private, no urls or titles); it waits for the start page's loading: false, the only sign of a loaded page that a private window's state gives, or the screenshot could show the page still loading (#567); a screenshot of its status bar (◆ private); ctrl+b ) leaves it for the first normal workspace; ctrl+shift+p goes back to the same window (no second one); ctrl+b shift+d then y closes it and the normal window is left. Xvfb has no window manager, so this is the X11 path: the private window opens over the Vimma window at its size and position.
